lines.text: Do not add am to work!
Many learners say: I am work in a bank.
Better: I work in a bank.
Work is a verb. Do not add am.
Works! My father works in a hospital.

data.wrong: I am work in a bank.
data.why: Work is a verb. Do not add am.
